result.reason: The redline appropriately extends use to Affiliates and contractors and is otherwise targeted. However, it does not provide that paid-up licences are perpetual and irrevocable or that subscription licences are terminable only for uncured material breach. Its successor-transfer right is also potentially defeated by the unchanged provision stating that any Change of Control is governed exclusively by the separate Change of Control section, which may capture mergers, acquisitions, reorganizations, and equity sales. The margin comment does not cure these operative deficiencies. Drafting is generally professional but contains this substantive conflict and an uncorrected missing punctuation break before “Subject to the terms of this Section.”
